correctness.rationale: Integral structure constants satisfy the Zinbiel identity. Left multiplication by e1 is a single nilpotent Jordan block, so all ideals are exactly tails. Lucas parity makes the least potentially nonzero degree inside tail Aj exactly j+t(j); a high-bit overlap proves no smaller degree works. The resulting threshold and piecewise beta formula are solved for all n>=2. The integer identity, parity checks, direct small-subspace ideal census, and n<=512 formula have independent reproducible test coverage, not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: The beta invariant is explicitly motivated in the reference literature as measuring maximal abelian ideals and relating to degenerations. Its familiar complex null-filiform value fails sharply after reduction modulo 2. The new result classifies every abelian two-sided ideal of the canonical modular family in every dimension, gives a closed binary-power cutoff and unique maximizer, and proves an unbounded characteristic-dependent gap. This is a natural infinite structural classification rather than an isolated small computation.
